Happy to help with that. Can you tell me which unit it is and what it's doing wrong? And do you have the order number it came on?

Once I know the fault, we troubleshoot it first, and if it needs replacing we sort the return and the replacement from here.
An Bs-2 ordernumber: Shop···· it is flashing red
Send me a support ticket, had to gl to work, I have filmed it, but haven't  taken a picture of the serial numbers

Back with you on the order side. It's logged against Shop····, nothing to do again, and the team is reviewing the return now. They'll confirm by email shortly.

No rush on the serial photo, send it whenever you're back from work and we'll add it.

One thing: what's the best email for you? The team is offline until 10am ET and that's where the confirmation and a copy of this chat will land.

Thanks, got it. Noting (email hidden) as the address for this one.

Your BS-2 on Shop····, delivered October 2, is logged as faulty and the team is reviewing the return now. They'll confirm by email, and they pick this up at 10am ET today.

Keep it unplugged, and send the serial photo whenever you're back. A copy of this chat goes to that email once we're done here.

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: RMA APPROVED by Georges for Marcus J. Bitfortun BS-2, serial (number hidden), order Shop···· ((address hidden), Sweden; delivered Oct 2). Pump stalls on start (slow red flash + ticking, video received), Hal and JD confirmed. Do the full RMA process now, the same way as the other EU BS-2 returns: open the return in ShipBob against Shop···· with reference Shop···· to our Rotterdam (NL) warehouse, quarantine, the BS-2 only (he keeps the power cable); arrange the prepaid return label from Sweden to Rotterdam and email it to him at (email hidden) with simple packing instructions (unit unplugged, coolant loop closed, do not open it, write Shop···· on the box). If a prepaid label from Sweden is not possible, tell him to ship it tracked to Rotterdam and that we add his shipping cost to the credit on receipt. Explain plainly: we have no BS-2 in stock, and once the unit arrives at our warehouse and is inspected, he chooses (a) $390.00 store credit on his HeliumDeploy account (the full amount he paid, including shipping), or (b) any miner of his choice with that $390.00 put toward it. Nothing ships before the unit is back and inspected - say that kindly. Apologise for the wait since October 9. Ask him to reply with his choice whenever he is ready. Log the return id, label tracking and cost.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.

I could not run this one. Shop···· was drop-shipped (Yun Express, the ShipBob copy ···· is cancelled), so `return_order.py` refuses at plan and at create, with or without a label: "nothing on this order has shipped from the warehouse". That means no Rotterdam return can be opened against it and no Easyship label can be bought from Sweden, so there is no return id, tracking or cost to log, and I have not written anything to Marcus.

Checks done: dispute check clear on all four of his orders; `returns.py` shows nothing ever sent back; order is PAID, FULFILLED, $390.00, delivered Oct 2 to (address hidden) SE.

Flagged to you (kind money) with the detail. What is needed from a person: the return route for a drop-shipped BS-2 (back to the maker, or a manual Rotterdam return opened by hand) and the prepaid label from Sweden. Tell me which, and I will send him the label link, the Shop···· reference, the packing instructions and the $390 store credit versus credit-toward-another-miner choice in one message.
